2026_03_LA_DEN.headline: Los Angeles brings a loaded pass rush into Denver’s test of pocket discipline
2026_03_LA_DEN.paragraph1: The Rams can change this matchup with their defensive front, where Myles Garrett adds another elite pressure threat to an already disruptive group. Denver’s response has to begin with protection, early-down efficiency and throws that keep the quarterback out of extended obvious passing situations. Los Angeles also has enough offensive firepower to punish short fields, so the Broncos cannot let sacks or turnovers compound. Denver’s defense must create pressure of its own without giving up explosive completions.
2026_03_LA_DEN.model_rationale: Los Angeles can tilt the game through its pass rush, while Denver needs efficient early downs and disciplined protection to keep the Rams from repeatedly attacking predictable situations.
